verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs say it ships retention insights, alongside lifecycle and stickiness, that can be saved to dashboards and alerted on (posthog-docs-15, posthog-docs-25, posthog-docs-2). Cohorts also exist as a product concept: they are used for flag targeting and have cohort read/write API scopes (posthog-docs-6, posthog-probe-6). However, nothing in the pack documents applying behavioral cohorts as a filter or breakdown on retention, so the slicing half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: documented retention breakdown/filter by behavioral cohorts, explicit behavioral cohort definitions (users who did X), detail on retention-over-time configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
